title: Whirlwind computer debuts core memory
lineage: Museum describes Navy flight-simulator project at MIT; August 1953 demonstration of 1024-core plane; IBM 737 announced 1954 with 4096 36-bit words and $6100 monthly rental. Other core researchers preceded the demonstration.
